pathways.subject: ITF
pathways.title: IT Support Fundamentals
objectives: Computer hardware and peripherals
Operating systems and basic administration
User accounts, permissions and endpoint security
Networking basics and connectivity troubleshooting
Helpdesk workflow, ticket quality and customer communication
Backup, recovery and safe escalation
pathways.source: Original Mock Night curriculum; not a vendor certification.

pathways.subject: CCN
pathways.title: Cisco CCST Networking 100-150
objectives: Standards and concepts: OSI/TCP-IP, network types, protocols and bandwidth
Addressing: IPv4, IPv6, private/public addressing, subnet masks and NAT
Endpoints and media: copper, fibre, Wi-Fi, cellular, devices and connectivity
Infrastructure: routers, switches, VLANs, ports, cabling and basic routing
Diagnostics: ping, ipconfig/ip, traceroute, nslookup, Wireshark and support tickets
Security: firewalls, CIA, AAA, MFA, encryption, threats and wireless security

pathways.subject: AWC
pathways.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02
objectives: Cloud value, shared responsibility and cloud economics
Security, compliance, identity and access management
Core AWS services, global infrastructure and cloud architecture concepts
Billing, pricing models, support plans and cost tools

pathways.subject: AZF
pathways.title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals AZ-900
objectives: Cloud computing, shared responsibility, cloud models, consumption and service types
Azure regions, availability zones, resources, subscriptions and management groups
Compute, networking, storage, identity, access and security
Cost management, governance, Azure Policy, resource locks, deployment and monitoring

pathways.subject: PCE
pathways.title: Python Programming Foundations — PCEP-30-03 aligned
objectives: Python syntax, variables, operators, input/output and type conversions
Conditions, loops, range, break, continue and pass
Lists, tuples, sets, dictionaries, strings, indexing and slicing
Functions, parameters, return values, scope and exception handling
Text files, CSV basics and importing standard-library modules
